_comment: Everything this project installs or relies on, with the exact command to undo it. Paths are relative to the project folder unless absolute.

installs.name: npm dependencies (package.json + package-lock.json)
installs.version: pinned by package-lock.json (15 runtime + 29 dev direct dependencies; licenses MIT / ISC / Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 for @axe-core/playwright, dev only)
installs.method: npm install (Start-GST-Billing.cmd runs it once on first start)

installs.name: Offline OCR assets (tesseract.js worker + core + English data)
npm overrides: minimatch ^11.0.4 (was 10.2.6) and glob ^14.0.3 for workbox-build (was 11.1.0)
installs.method: Fixes GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (minimatch ReDoS) and GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (glob) in dev tooling. Verified: lint, typecheck, 173 tests, build (PWA precache 24 entries) and e2e all pass.
installs.uninstall: Delete the "overrides" block from package.json, then run: npm install

used_but_not_installed_by_this_project.name: Node.js
used_but_not_installed_by_this_project.note: required to run server.js and to build
